entries.title: Proverbs 21:1
segments: ¶The king's heart [is] in the hand of the LORD, [as] the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:2
segments: ¶Every way of a man [is] right in his own eyes: but the LORD pondereth the hearts.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:3
segments: ¶To do justice and judgment [is] more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:4
segments: ¶An high look, and a proud heart, [and] the plowing of the wicked, [is] sin. {An...: Heb. Haughtiness of eyes} {the plowing: or, the light}

words.text: . {An...: Heb. Haughtiness of eyes} {the plowing: or, the light}

entries.title: Proverbs 21:5
segments: ¶The thoughts of the diligent [tend] only to plenteousness; but of every one [that is] hasty only to want.

words.text: ; but of every one [that is] hasty

entries.title: Proverbs 21:6
segments: ¶The getting of treasures by a lying tongue [is] a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:7
segments: ¶The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment. {destroy...: Heb. saw them, or, dwell with them}

words.text: . {destroy...: Heb. saw them, or, dwell with them}

entries.title: Proverbs 21:8
segments: ¶The way of man [is] froward and strange: but [as for] the pure, his work [is] right.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:9
segments: ¶[It is] better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house. {a brawling...: Heb. a woman of contentions} {a wide...: Heb. an house of society}

words.text: . {a brawling...: Heb. a woman of contentions} {a wide...: Heb. an house of society}

entries.title: Proverbs 21:10
segments: ¶The soul of the wicked desireth evil: his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes. {findeth...: Heb. is not favoured}

entries.title: Proverbs 21:11
segments: ¶When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:12
segments: ¶The righteous [man] wisely considereth the house of the wicked: [but God] overthroweth the wicked for [their] wickedness.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:13
segments: ¶Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.

words.text: himself, but shall not be heard

entries.title: Proverbs 21:14
segments: ¶A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:15
segments: ¶[It is] joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction [shall be] to the workers of iniquity.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:16
segments: ¶The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:17
segments: ¶He that loveth pleasure [shall be] a poor man: he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich. {pleasure: or, sport}

entries.title: Proverbs 21:18
segments: ¶The wicked [shall be] a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:19
segments: ¶[It is] better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman. {in...: Heb. in the land of the desert}

words.text: . {in...: Heb. in the land of the desert}

entries.title: Proverbs 21:20
segments: ¶[There is] treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:21
segments: ¶He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, righteousness, and honour.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:22
segments: ¶A wise [man] scaleth the city of the mighty, and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:23
segments: ¶Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:24
segments: ¶Proud [and] haughty scorner [is] his name, who dealeth in proud wrath. {in proud...: Heb. in the wrath of pride}

words.text: . {in proud...: Heb. in the wrath of pride}

entries.title: Proverbs 21:25
segments: ¶The desire of the slothful killeth him; for his hands refuse to labour.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:26
segments: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth and spareth not.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:27
segments: ¶The sacrifice of the wicked [is] abomination: how much more, [when] he bringeth it with a wicked mind? {with...: Heb. in wickedness?}

entries.title: Proverbs 21:28
segments: ¶A false witness shall perish: but the man that heareth speaketh constantly. {A...: Heb. A witness of lies}

entries.title: Proverbs 21:29
segments: ¶A wicked man hardeneth his face: but [as for] the upright, he directeth his way. {directeth: or, considereth}

entries.title: Proverbs 21:30
segments: ¶[There is] no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:31
segments: The horse [is] prepared against the day of battle: but safety [is] of the LORD. {safety: or, victory}
